lines.1: --After school, we gathered in the student council room.
lines.5: 「No kidding. Great base for a nap.」
lines.6: Fukahire and Crab sat at the table, stuffing their faces with tea snacks.
lines.7: Subaru was stretched out on the sofa.
lines.8: They had made themselves completely at home.
lines.12: 「When it comes to food, you're truly international.」
lines.13: 「I see you've made yourselves comfortable. Well, this room is one of the student council's privileges, so feel free to relax like that whenever there is no work to do.」
lines.14: 「Now that's a leader who understands! As expected of the Princess.」
lines.16: We were starting to look like a band of outlaws.
